name: Cozy Cubing Poway 2023
information:
Competitors at this competition are encouraged to wear pajamas! If you come dressed in pajamas you will be given one raffle ticket and entered into a raffle for a prize! The raffle will be held during lunch.

This competition is recognized as an official World Cube Association competition. Therefore, all competitors must be familiar with the [WCA Regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/). If you are new to competing, please refer to the [Competitor Responsibilities](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/CozyCubingPoway2023#23980-competitor-responsibilities) tab.
